observations: Single black plastic pallet shown, leaning upright against an exterior wall.
Pallet has a grid/lattice deck design with four large open pockets and reinforced rib structure, typical of a nine-leg or similar plastic pallet.
Surface shows dirt, dust, and some grime/staining consistent with prior outdoor or warehouse use.
A faint watermark reading 'JOHNSON OLUWATOBILOBA' overlays the image.
No manufacturer logo, brand mark, or model number visible on the pallet itself.
Only one physical unit is visible in the photo despite seller stating three are available.
Background shows a rough concrete wall, a window frame, and a bucket, suggesting an outdoor/yard storage setting.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows visible dirt, grime, and wear consistent with prior use.
Only one pallet is visible in photo 0; no image shows a stack or group of three.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, broken legs, or structural damage on the underside or corners not visible in this single angled shot.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the underside (leg/block structure) and all four corners.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically used with unknown structural integrity, i.e., at the low end for used pallets.

risks.risk: Inconsistent condition across the other two units claimed to be available.
risks.proof: Individual photos of all three pallets side by side.
risks.if_unproven: Each additional unit priced the same as the worst-condition unit shown, not assumed better.

risks.risk: Exact size/load rating unknown, which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure against the pallet edge, or a stamped size/weight marking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard/generic size pallet without premium for load capacity.

proof_requests: Photo of the underside of the pallet showing legs/feet and any cracks.
Photo showing all three pallets together for condition comparison.
A tape measure shot against the pallet for exact dimensions.
Any stamped manufacturer/load rating mark, if present.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used plastic pallet type even without brand data, and visible wear lets it be priced at worst-case used condition; the '3 units' claim and hidden structural condition remain unverified but do not block a worst-case price.
